translation.spanish: Postrándonos a los Pies del Guru, vivimos en Paz y en Éxtasis. Logrando este Tesoro

english.default: Meeting with the treasure of peace, their pains are taken away; granting His Grace, God protects them.

translation.spanish: nuestras aflicciones desaparecen y el Señor, en Su Misericordia, nos salva.

english.default: Those who grasp the Lord's feet - their fears and doubts run away, and they chant the Name of the Lord.
